alt: 溪水退去後，原先藏在水面下的大石頭完整露出，岸邊的人終於看清它的模樣。
scene_prompt: 水落石出 literally means receding water exposes the rocks, metaphorically the truth is revealed as uncertainty clears. A modern nature-park creek after rain, in ONE softly linked before-and-after composition. LEFT small vignette: high cloudy water covers most of a large distinctive rounded rock, only a tiny tip visible. RIGHT dominant scene: the SAME creek with much lower clear water exposes the SAME entire large rock and smaller stones, and two modern children with a parent point in recognition from the SAFE dry bank. Clear visual transition from concealed to fully revealed. No lettering, arrows or labels, no flood danger or anyone in the creek. Natural pale blue water and warm brown-gray stone.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper.
